President Murmu Presents Awards at 72nd National Film Awards

President Droupadi Murmu presented the 72nd National Film Awards, honouring winners including Mammootty, Kartik Aaryan and Yami Gautam. The awards ceremony also includes cash prizes for the winners, as noted by coverage. Republic World reported that Yami Gautam received the Best Actress award for Article 370.
